name: Supply and Installation
summary: HVAC, plumbing, fire suppression, refrigeration and indoor environment systems, supplied and installed as one scope.
intro: The HVACR and MEP Services Division, established in 2007, supplies, installs and commissions chillers, air handling units, CAC, light commercial equipment and the allied MEP around them.
applies: Industrial complexes, high-rise commercial buildings and government facilities.

name: Service, Operation and Maintenance
summary: Scheduled care and 24-hour cover that keep an installed HVAC system at the performance it was designed for.
intro: Operation and maintenance keeps mechanical systems efficient through the life of the building. The after-sales desk is 0343 8248687.
points: Daily, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual and annual fixed-rate contracts
24-hour operation and maintenance, with or without parts
applies: Buildings where Cosmix has supplied or installed the plant, and sites that engage the service team directly.

name: Allied MEP
summary: Plumbing, power plant, mechanical utilities, fire suppression and cold storage beside the air-conditioning scope.
intro: The division’s allied work covers water supply and drainage, combined heat and power, steam and compressed air, fire pumps and sprinklers, and refrigeration for cold storage and abattoirs.
points: Water supply, drainage, filtration and gas distribution
Combined heating, cooling and power, pump rooms and chilled-water circuits
Steam, medical gases and industrial utilities
Fire pumps, hydrants, sprinklers, foam and gas extinguishment
applies: Agreed per building, from a single utility to a full MEP package.

name: Testing and Commissioning
summary: Commissioning against the design, with the measuring equipment controlled and the results recorded.
intro: Installation is closed out with testing and commissioning. Measuring and monitoring devices are identified, calibrated and traceable, and a nonconforming result is recorded before the system is handed over.
points: Inspection and test against the project plan
Nonconforming work rejected, repaired or reworked, then verified again
applies: Every commissioned HVACR and MEP installation.

name: Indoor Environment
summary: Ventilation schemes for hospitals, laboratories, kitchens, workshops and worship spaces.
intro: Indoor environment work covers demand-controlled ventilation, filtration, radon mitigation, and schemes for hospitals, pharmaceutical rooms, kitchens, paint and welding shops, auditoriums and worship spaces.
applies: Specialist rooms where the air itself is part of the process.

name: Ducting and Air Distribution
summary: Air distribution installed to SMACNA and the Air Diffusion Council, as part of the turn-key scope.
intro: Ducted systems are installed with the rest of the plant. The project standards include SMACNA and the Air Diffusion Council, alongside ASHRAE 55, 62.1 and 90.1.
points: Ducted air distribution for central and unitary systems
Installation coordinated with the air handler or VRF indoor unit
Workmanship recorded in the project quality plan
applies: Central plants, VRF indoor units and fresh-air systems.
